# Who is involved

**Active cast.** "Mice fish" and "fish presenting their shit on stage." Any contributor "coming up on stage receiving a badge." The "core group of mice" or "core group of hitchhiker fellows" for the year, who are the intended 42k prize recipients. The event runs across "42 venues even if they're just someone's bedroom," with "global coverage." The pair themselves frame and host ("it's our agm"). Named funders are positioned to act by pledging: "ethereum foundation have pledged," "solana foundation."

**Being invited or network activated.** "Any partner." "Any guide, and the capital G guide is also involved, so anyone who's authored a guide will be involved." The Ethereum Foundation and Solana Foundation as aspirational pledgers creating "a peer pressure moment." The 42 venues as an organising network to be stood up for the July 2027 date, timed to "the festival circuit" after "universities are broken up."
